description: This file contains utility functions `omit` and `pick` for manipulating objects, allowing exclusion or inclusion of specified keys.

methods.name: export function omit<T extends object, U extends (keyof T)[]>( omit
methods.description: Returns a new object excluding the specified keys.

methods.name: export function pick<T extends object, U extends (keyof T)[]>( pick
methods.description: Returns a new object including only the specified keys.

ctags.name: omit
ctags.pattern: /^export function omit<T extends object, U extends (keyof T)[]>($/

ctags.name: pick
ctags.pattern: /^export function pick<T extends object, U extends (keyof T)[]>($/
